A '''Human''' [[Gender/Legends|female]] lived in a [[Unidentified Ragmar V settlement|settlement of outcasts]] around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the final [[Time/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The Human took part in a [[Battle of Ragmar V|fight]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ragmar V]] that was fought against the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone armies]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The battle was originally planned to be set against a detachment of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and their [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]], [[Joc Sah]]. The fight unexpectedly took a different turn however when the clone troopers were ordered to execute [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]; a [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|directive]] that labeled all Jedi as traitors to the Republic and that they were to be [[Death/Legends|executed]] immediately. The settlement leader, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Gaan]], made peace with Joc Sah, and together with the other settlers they repelled the clone troopers. The girl took her place on a rooftop with [[Unidentified Rodian outcast|three]] [[Unidentified Klatooinian outcast 1|other]] [[Unidentified Bith outcast|outcasts]] for the fight. She survived the encounter with Sah's [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], and fought against another detachment of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that arrived soon after to ensure Sah's elimination. The girl hung out with a [[Unidentified outcast wearing the helmet|Human male outcast]].<ref name="TOO" />
